_comment: Golden vectors of the readable English diagnostics report: `diagnostics` is the exact text the bug form is prefilled with (fields.diagnostics of the share document, the complete report's start before its JSON block). Replayed byte for byte by share.lua (macOS and Linux suites), model.js (tools/test/fixtures/healthcheck-sharing-controls.cjs) and report.ahk (AHK suite), because the host refuses a page preview that differs from its own text. The groups follow share_policy.report_order: errors first, the unbounded changed settings last. `large` builds a configuration of `large.rows` changed settings on top of the first vector's snapshot: its errors, checks and permissions must still reach the bug link whole, ahead of the cut.
